మీరు వండే వెజ్ లేదా నాన్-వెజ్ గ్రేవీ కూరలు నీళ్లలా పలచగా అనిపిస్తున్నాయా? ఈ సింపుల్ కిచెన్ టిప్ పాటించండి!
​గ్రేవీ వండేటప్పుడు ఒక చెంచా వేయించిన పుట్నాల పప్పుల పొడి (Roasted Gram Powder) లేదా జీడిపప్పు పేస్ట్ (Cashew Paste) కలిపితే, గ్రేవీ కి మంచి చిక్కదనంతో పాటు అద్భుతమైన కమ్మటి రుచి వస్తుంది.
​🔔 మరింత సమాచారం & వంటల టిప్స్ కోసం Subscribe చేయండి!

snippet.description:
The endocrine system and hypothalamus are fundamental topics in Class 12 Biology that explain how our body maintains homeostasis through hormonal regulation. This comprehensive video covers the structure and function of the endocrine system, with special focus on the hypothalamus as the master control center.

In this video, you will learn:
• What is the endocrine system and its role in the body
• Anatomy and functions of the hypothalamus
• Connection between the hypothalamus and pituitary gland
• Major endocrine glands and their hormones
• Neuroendocrine mechanisms and feedback loops
• How hormones regulate body processes

Understanding the endocrine system is crucial for CBSE and NCERT board exams. The hypothalamus acts as the bridge between the nervous and endocrine systems, making it a key concept for competitive exams like NEET and JEE. This detailed explanation will help you grasp hormonal regulation, glandular functions, and physiological processes that are frequently asked in exams.

Perfect for:
✓ Class 12 Biology students
✓ CBSE and NCERT curriculum
✓ Board exam preparation
✓ NEET and competitive exam aspirants
✓ Quick revision and concept clarity
